pass_5888_stabiliser.reading: ONE hit in 3000 is consistent with a trivial stabiliser -- plausibly the identity from a trivial random word. An extrapolated order is meaningless at this count and is NOT reported
pass_5888_stabiliser.self_correction: my printed prose said '0 of 3000' where the data said 1, and quoted an extrapolated order of ~1560 from that single hit. Fourth prose-versus-output slip this session; both corrected before commit

pass_5889_not_an_orbit.necessary_condition: a set that is one orbit has setwise stabiliser of order >= 18
pass_5889_not_an_orbit.observed: at most 1 of 3000 sampled elements stabilises the 18-set
pass_5889_not_an_orbit.verdict: alpha(W(3,5)) = 18 is NOT an orbit of any large subgroup
pass_5889_not_an_orbit.why_it_matters: the small-stabiliser property is not specific to q=9. It holds where alpha is PROVED OPTIMAL, which is stronger than the q=9 case where 51 is only an incumbent -- so the four failed generator classes at q=9 were not an artefact of chasing a non-optimal target

pass_5890_guard.deliberate: a certificate with three witnesses against a population of 240 is flagged even when its prose is scrupulous; the flag is about COVERAGE, not wording
pass_5890_guard.motivation: neither check_transitivity nor an integrity audit catches both lanes' failures; this tests the join -- claims whose EVIDENCE does not reach their SCOPE
